description: Option chain, expiration dates, historical option contract bars, and Black-Scholes Greeks lookup for a single underlying ticker: returns available expiration dates and liquid call/put contracts with strike, bid, ask, implied volatility, volume, open interest and Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho). When strike is also provided (with expiration and option_type call/put), returns historical daily OHLCV, open interest, implied volatility and Black-Scholes Greeks for that active or expired option contract.

expiration.description: Optional expiration date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-11-20). Required when strike is specified for historical contract bars

from.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format when strike is specified for historical option bars

limit.description: Maximum number of option contracts or historical daily bars to return, 1-50 (default 10 for chains, 30 for historical bars)

option_type.description: Optional contract type filter: all (default: both calls and puts), call or put

strike.description: Optional strike price (e.g. 200 or 345) to retrieve historical daily OHLCV, Open Interest, Implied Volatility and Black-Scholes Greeks for a specific active or expired option contract (requires expiration and option_type call or put)

symbol.description: Underlying equity or ETF ticker in standard market notation, e.g. AAPL, NVDA, SPY, QQQ

to.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format when strike is specified for historical option bars

name: get_options_chain
